headline: Storytellers & Brand Founders - Mary's Big 30 AI Story Project
body: Posted in last 7 days Storytellers & Brand Founders - Mary's Big 30 AI Story Project EVERYONE HAS AN UNTOLD STORY. ❤️ I’m turning 30 this October, and I want to do something different. For my Big 30, I want to hear 30 stories from 30 people and bring selected stories to life using AI, creativity and storytelling. Tell me about: 🎓 Your university struggle 💻 Your transition into Tech 💰 Your first good-paying remote job 🚀 Your business journey 😭 A difficult season you survived ❤️ Someone who changed your life 🔥 A rejection that shaped you 🏆 A breakthrough you’re proud of Or simply tell me a story you’ve always wanted people to hear. Drop it in the comments or send me a DM if it’s personal. I’ll use my own AI credits to create the stories, and then we’ll all watch them and vote for our favourite. 🏆 The winning story goes home with a ₦20,000 token. And hey, brands are welcome too! 👀 Do you have a brand with a story behind it? Tell us about your brand. Tell us how you started. Tell us what problem you’re solving. Tell us what nobody knows about the journey. You could become one of the stories I bring to life. And if you’d like to sponsor Mary’s Big 30, you’re welcome. 🤝🏾 This isn't just my birthday challenge. It’s a celebration of people, stories, businesses, struggles and breakthroughs. 30 DAYS. 30 STORIES. 30 TRANSFORMATIONS. Everyone has a story. What’s yours? ❤️ #MarysBig30 #EveryoneHasAStory #TellYourStory #AIStorytelling

headline: Parents, Freelancers & Students - Real Cost of Digital Disconnection
body: Posted in last 7 days Parents, Freelancers & Students - Real Cost of Digital Disconnection #journorequest I'm working on a feature about the real cost of trying to be less digitally connected. What do people actually give up or struggle with when they try this? Did they find a fix, and was it worth it, in money, effort, or peace of mind? Or did they just give up? I want to hear from people across different walks of life: parents, freelancers, trekkers, students, anyone who has genuinely tried to be less connected and can speak to what that really cost them. If this is you, or someone you know, I'd love to talk. Comment, DM, drop me an email, or tag someone who'd have a story to share. email me here: [email redacted]
